title: Register 5 dormant evaluators + structured score transport
description: F1 Evaluator Expansion: Register pyramid, subtext, four_selves, cliche, deadly_sins evaluators in CriticEngine. Add structured per-module score transport alongside existing 3-score mapping in critic.js service. Add per-module evaluation endpoint to frontend API.
action: Register 5 evaluator classes (PyramidEvaluator, SubtextEvaluator, FourSelvesEvaluator, ClicheDetector, DeadlySinsChecker) in critic-engine.js this.evaluators map, update weights, modify critic.js to transport structured moduleScores alongside existing 3 flat scores, add getModuleScores endpoint to evaluation.ts

criteria: critic-engine.js this.weights has 10 entries (5 existing + 5 new)
critic.js evaluate function returns object containing 'module_scores' key alongside 'lock_score', 'style_score', 'logic_score'
Existing test suite passes (3-score backward compat)
convergence.verification: Run existing test suite. Call critic evaluate endpoint and verify response contains both flat 3-score fields AND structured module_scores field with 10 evaluator keys.
convergence.definition_of_done: All 10 evaluators registered, per-module scores transportable via API, existing 3-score UI continues working

files.change: Add 5 new evaluator entries: pyramid: new PyramidEvaluator(llmClient), subtext: new SubtextEvaluator(llmClient), four_selves: new FourSelvesEvaluator(llmClient), cliche: new ClicheDetector(llmClient), deadly_sins: new DeadlySinsChecker(llmClient). Update this.weights to include pyramid: 0.12, subtext: 0.10, four_selves: 0.10, cliche: 0.08, deadly_sins: 0.08.

Add module_scores field to evaluate return object at lines 49-56 and lines 188-198. module_scores = raw moduleScores object from CriticEngine, keeping existing lock_score/style_score/logic_score fields unchanged.
Add module_scores: Record<string, number> to EvaluationResult interface. Add evaluateWithModules() function calling POST /critic/evaluate with include_modules=true query param.

implementation: In critic-engine.js constructor: import 5 dormant evaluator classes, add them to this.evaluators map after voice entry at line 97

In critic-engine.js constructor: add 5 new weight entries to this.weights object after line 104, distributing weight from existing entries (reduce dream from 0.25 to 0.20, voice from 0.20 to 0.15 to make room)
In critic.js evaluate() method (line 49-56): add 'module_scores: moduleScores' to the return object alongside existing lockScore/styleScore/logicScore
In critic.js fallback path (line 188-198): add 'module_scores: moduleScores' to the fallback return object
In evaluation.ts: add 'module_scores?: Record<string, number>' to EvaluationResult interface
In evaluation.ts: add evaluateWithModules() function that calls POST /critic/evaluate with { content, context, include_module_scores: true }

integration: Call evaluate endpoint, verify response has both flat scores and module_scores with 10 keys
success_metrics: New endpoint returns structured per-module data

reference.pattern: BaseEvaluator subclass pattern: get name(), get description(), get relatedSkill(), evaluate(content, context) → { score, details }
reference.examples: critic-engine.js lines 84-104 show existing 5-evaluator registration + weights pattern

rationale.chosen_approach: Register all 5 dormant evaluators at once in CriticEngine constructor, transport structured scores alongside flat scores
decision_factors: All 5 evaluators follow identical BaseEvaluator pattern
Backward compatibility requires keeping flat scores
rationale.tradeoffs: Adding all 5 at once increases change surface, but evaluators are isolated units with no coupling

risks.risk: New evaluator weights unbalanced vs existing
risks.mitigation: Start with conservative weights (0.08-0.12), can tune after deployment

risks.mitigation: Use distinct key name 'module_scores' that doesn't exist in current response
